# Digital Multiplex — Comprehensive Architecture & API Documentation
> Full Technical Specification for Autonomous Multi-Agent AI Cinema, Music & Media Production Hub

- **Platform Name:** Digital Multiplex
- **Author & Lead Architect:** Alok Srivastava
- **GitHub Repository:** https://github.com/alokinfo30/Digital-Multiplex
- **Core Technologies:** Python 3.11, CrewAI, Flask, OpenRouter (GPT-4o, Mistral 8x22B, Llama 3.3, Claude 3.5), TMDB API, LibreTranslate, Web Audio API, Web Speech API.

---

## 1. System Overview
Digital Multiplex is a next-generation decentralized entertainment production platform. It coordinates specialized autonomous AI agents to dynamically generate Hollywood-grade movie screenplays, song lyrics with chord notations, live radio broadcasts, 4K documentary scripts, and podcast show notes customized across 3 age tiers and 14+ languages with automatic location detection.

---

## 2. The 8 Interactive Experience Hubs
1. **Cinema Studio**: Generates loglines, character ensembles, scene setups [INT/EXT], formatted dialogue, and production metadata.
2. **Music Studio**: Generates verses, chorus, hook, bridge, BPM tempo, musical key, and guitar/piano chords (`[Am] [F] [C] [G]`).
3. **Radio & Talk Show**: Late-night RJ broadcasts, caller phone-in dialogue, sponsor spots, and soundbed cues.
4. **Documentary Vault**: Cinematic 4K docu-series narrations on cosmos, nature, wilderness, and deep technology.
5. **Podcast Hub**: Multi-host conversational breakdowns, episode outlines, and actionable show notes.
6. **VIP Seat Matrix**: Interactive IMAX screen and seat reservation engine with NFC smart turnstile simulator.
7. **Concessions Express**: Gourmet popcorn, nachos, slushies cart with real-time promo code engine (`MULTIPLEX20`).
8. **Cinephile Trivia Arena**: Gamified 5-question pop-culture quiz with instant scoring and Multiplex Stars loyalty wallet.

---

## 3. Location-Based Language Auto-Detection
The client automatically discovers user timezone and browser locale to serve the optimal language:
- `hi`: Hindi (India)
- `en`: English (Global)
- `es`: Spanish (Spain & Latin America)
- `fr`: French (France & Francophone)
- `de`: German (Germany & Austria)
- `pt`: Portuguese (Brazil & Portugal)
- `ar`: Arabic (Middle East & North Africa)
- `zh`: Chinese (China & East Asia)
- `ja`: Japanese (Japan)
- `ko`: Korean (South Korea)
- `it`: Italian (Italy)
- `ru`: Russian (Eastern Europe)
- `nl`: Dutch (Netherlands)
- `tr`: Turkish (Turkey)

---

## 4. API Endpoints
- `GET /health` & `GET /api/health`: System heartbeat.
- `GET /api/languages`: Supported language list.
- `POST /api/generate`: Multi-agent entertainment generation dispatcher.
- `GET /api/result/<job_id>`: Asynchronous background polling.
